createTable.remarks: Recommendations (components for scoring) a Trigger Ingredient contributes to the score of a recipe that contains it

Working Copy mirror of DW_TRIGGER_INGREDIENT_COMPONENTS_FOR_SCORING: staged changes to which Recommendations (components for scoring) a Trigger Ingredient contributes; sparse, a row exists only while the effective link differs from published master

column.name: trigger_ingredient_id
column.remarks: The Trigger Ingredient; resolved against master union Working Copy, not a foreign key

column.name: recommendation_id
column.remarks: The Recommendation whose component for scoring this Trigger Ingredient contributes; resolved against published master, not a foreign key

column.name: present
column.remarks: Staged effective presence of the link: true = staged addition (absent in master), false = staged removal (present in master)

changeSet.author: nikospara
changeSet.comment: Seeds the components of every Trigger Ingredient with the Recommendations of its Rules, active or not, as the starting point the scientific partners refine in the backoffice.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO DW_TRIGGER_INGREDIENT_COMPONENTS_FOR_SCORING (trigger_ingredient_id, recommendation_id) SELECT DISTINCT trigger_ingredient_id, recommendation_id FROM DW_RULE
